svg.font-family: Amazon Ember, Inter, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
svg.title: How ESHANA answers a question

g.text: One Rust engine behind every surface. Calculated, derived and interpretive stay apart in the data, and every result says how it was made.
1 · A birth or event in local civil time is resolved to UTC first, or refused with a stable code
2 · The engine receives an exact instant and place
3 · Positions come from a measured provider: the calculated layer
4 · Nakshatras, vargas, daśās, muhūrta, KP: each from a named, versioned rule
5 · Everything returns in one envelope, with every assumption recorded
6 · Surfaces only render: the studio, files and images never compute a factor of their own
DST gaps and folds: errors, not guesses
